assets.prompt: Use: character reference portrait, the identity anchor for every later shot. Scene: plain flat light-grey seamless background. Subject: Rani, woman, late 20s, warm medium skin with natural texture, dark brown hair in a low messy bun, thin silver necklace, black hair tie on left wrist, neutral relaxed expression, facing camera. Details: wearing a plain cream t-shirt. Composition: waist-up portrait, centered, eye level. Style: phone photo, candid, unposed. Lighting: soft natural daylight from the left. Constraints: natural skin texture, visible pores, no beauty filter, no smoothing. Avoid: studio-perfect symmetry, airbrushed skin, jewelry or wardrobe not listed above, text, logos.

Use: empty location plate, the environment anchor for desk shots. Scene: small apartment desk corner, off-white wall, light wood desk. Subject: the desk and wall, no people. Details: a closed laptop, a ceramic mug, a folded thin blanket on the chair back. Composition: chest-height eye-level framing, vertical. Style: phone photo, candid. Lighting: soft morning daylight from a window on the left. Constraints: no people, no text, no signage. Avoid: clutter, brand logos, screens showing content.
